name: openpixo/level-design-tilemap
title: 2D level and tilemap design
description: Build readable 2D levels with Godot TileMapLayer, Tiled or LDtk data, measured jump distances, collision layers, safe introductions and deliberate difficulty ramps.

description_i18n.en: Build readable 2D levels with Godot TileMapLayer, Tiled or LDtk data, measured jump distances, collision layers, safe introductions and deliberate difficulty ramps.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用 Godot TileMapLayer、Tiled 或 LDtk 数据构建易读的 2D 关卡，量化跳跃距离，设置碰撞层、安全教学段和难度递进。

examples.title: Build a three-beat platforming level

title_i18n.zh-CN: 构建三个教学段的平台跳跃关卡

examples.prompt: Extend this Phaser sample platformer's level into a short route that teaches a low jump, repeats it with a wider landing, then offers an optional coin detour before the flag. Budget gaps from the current controller, keep a safe first landing, and verify check/build/run with a screenshot.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 把这个 Phaser 示例平台跳跃关卡扩展为一条短路线：先教低跳，再用更宽的落点重复练习，最后在旗帜前提供可选金币支路。根据当前控制器量化间隙，保留安全的第一个落点，并执行 check/build/run 验证和截图。

examples.title: Add a Godot tilemap room

title_i18n.zh-CN: 添加 Godot 瓦片地图房间

examples.prompt: In this Godot 2D project, build one readable room with a solid TileMapLayer, a separate decoration layer, a safe spawn and an exit. Reuse the existing tiles if available; otherwise use a small consistent placeholder tileset. Check collision masks and verify the room loads before testing the route.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 在这个 Godot 2D 项目中构建一个易读的房间，包含实体 TileMapLayer、独立装饰层、安全出生点和出口。优先复用已有瓦片，否则使用风格一致的小型占位瓦片集。检查碰撞掩码，先验证房间能加载，再试玩路线。

examples.title: Repair a map import
examples.prompt: Inspect this project's Tiled or LDtk map and its existing loader. Fix misaligned spawn objects and missing solid-tile collisions without changing the authoring format. Document the tile size, layer offsets and entity anchors, then verify and play the route from spawn to exit.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 检查项目中的 Tiled 或 LDtk 地图及现有加载器。保持创作格式不变，修复出生对象错位和实体瓦片碰撞缺失的问题。记录瓦片大小、层偏移和实体锚点，然后验证并从出生点试玩到出口。
